from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One provided paper: its title and which other provided papers it cites."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of this paper")
    cites_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers that appear in this paper's reference list (known from the document summaries)")
    is_cited_by_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers that cite this paper in their reference lists (known from the document summaries)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
